import openpyxl, os, sys
from copy import copy
from openpyxl.styles.colors import Color
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

target_p = r'C:\Users\lg\Desktop\Today\(안상숙)(STI)_(모집단현행화)_부산정보산업진흥원_2026_부산_CT산업_실태조사_260910_크레탑_배현명.xlsx'
backup_p = r'C:\Users\lg\Desktop\Today\(안상숙)(STI)_(모집단현행화)_부산정보산업진흥원_2026_부산_CT산업_실태조사_260910_크레탑_배현명__BACKUP_20260921_090440.xlsx'
temp_p = r'C:\Users\lg\Desktop\Today\(안상숙)(STI)_(모집단현행화)_부산정보산업진흥원_2026_부산_CT산업_실태조사_260910_크레탑_배현명_TEMP.xlsx'

print('Loading workbooks...')
wb_t = openpyxl.load_workbook(target_p)
wb_b = openpyxl.load_workbook(backup_p, data_only=True)

ws_t = wb_t['기업체 리스트']
ws_b = wb_b['기업체 리스트']
headers = [ws_t.cell(1, c).value for c in range(1, ws_t.max_column+1)]

RED_COLOR = Color(rgb='FFFF0000')

updated_cells = []

for r in range(2, 2315):
    for c in range(1, ws_t.max_column+1):
        cell_t = ws_t.cell(r, c)
        vt = cell_t.value
        vb = ws_b.cell(r, c).value
        st = str(vt).strip() if vt is not None else ''
        sb = str(vb).strip() if vb is not None else ''
        if st != sb and st != '':
            is_red = False
            if cell_t.font and cell_t.font.color and str(cell_t.font.color.rgb) in ['FFFF0000', 'FFFF3300', 'FFED0000']:
                is_red = True
            if not is_red:
                # Update font color to red
                if cell_t.font:
                    new_font = copy(cell_t.font)
                    new_font.color = RED_COLOR
                    cell_t.font = new_font
                else:
                    cell_t.font = openpyxl.styles.Font(name='맑은 고딕', size=10, color=RED_COLOR)
                
                company = ws_t.cell(r, 3).value
                updated_cells.append((r, company, c, headers[c-1], vb, vt))

print(f'Total cells updated to RED font: {len(updated_cells)}')

print('Saving to TEMP file...')
wb_t.save(temp_p)
wb_t.close()
wb_b.close()
print('TEMP file successfully saved! Size:', os.path.getsize(temp_p))
